provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The ADV B model curve gets an additional -0.25 s shift (L65) on top of the global -0.25 s in L32, while ADV A uses the global shift only (L46) -- total shifts differ between panels without in-file justification.

text('ADV A') and legend are issued at L57-58 after the B-station data have replaced data/vel/veldata (L51-56) but before subplot(212); they still target the first axes only because subplot(212) is created at L60 -- fragile ordering.

n is set to 6 at L37/L53 overwriting the column count from size (L10), and vel is padded to 6 columns though only column 1 is plotted; m from L36/L52 overwrites the FSE record length; num_shift_ind/exp_shift_ind (L18, L26) unused.
Peak alignment uses eta column 1 of the model FSE file vs column 2 of WG1.txt (L17 vs L25); which gauge model column 1 corresponds to is not stated in this file.
Demeaning by mean(veldata(1:25,2)) (L43, L62) assumes the first 25 samples are still water; sampling rates of the measured files are not stated.

audit_member_text: If eta(:,1) or WGdata(:,2) contains NaN, max at lines 17 or 25 can be NaN and equality is false for every iteration; empty inputs also skip the loops. num_t_shift and/or exp_t_shift are then used before assignment at line 32.

Line 32 already subtracts 0.25 from the shared model time, line 46 plots ADV A against that shifted t, and line 65 subtracts another 0.25 only for ADV B. No comment or separate B alignment calculation explains the cumulative 0.50-second B shift, making this a likely copied double shift/interface mismatch.

Measured plotting at lines 43 and 62 uses length(veldata) as a row bound. Because MATLAB length returns the largest dimension, a file with fewer rows than columns indexes beyond its row range; size(veldata,1) is the required interface dimension.

Measured mean removal at lines 43 and 62 unconditionally indexes rows 1:25 and column 2, while model extraction at lines 39 and 55 requires at least two input columns. Short or narrow files fail with no validation.

The time vector t comes from datae rows at line 11, whereas vel rows come from independently loaded A/B files at lines 35 and 51. Plots at lines 46 and 65 require equal vector lengths, but neither A nor B row count is checked against length(t).

vel is preallocated with six columns at lines 38 and 54, but the copy ranges at lines 39 and 55 are driven by nn from each input file. nn-1 greater than six silently expands the buffer, while nn-1 below six leaves zero-filled unused columns; n=6 at lines 37 and 53 is never used to enforce the apparent six-column contract.

num_shift_ind and exp_shift_ind are assigned at lines 18 and 26 but never read, and n is overwritten at lines 37 and 53 without being consumed; these are dead copy/paste remnants rather than active controls.
Division by fact occurs at lines 46 and 65 without a nonzero check; the current default at line 4 is safe, but the exposed parameter becomes singular if changed to zero.
